CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE ASHOK S.KINAGI  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners filed this writ petition seeking for quashing the impugned notice dated 10.09.2024 issued by respondent No.3 vide Annexure-A, etc.
2.

The brief facts leading rise to the filing of this Writ Petition are as follows:
The petitioner No.1 is the sister of petitioner No.2.

Both the petitioners are carrying on business of chicken slaughter unit and cold storage of dressed chicken under NC:
2024:KHC:40947 the name & style of M/s. TDL Feed and Farms.

The petitioners submits that they have obtained Food License dated 23.08.2024, under FSS Act,
2006, vide License No.11224332000934 from the Government of Karnataka, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), valid from 23.08.2024 to 22.08.2025, and the same was issued by the Designated Officer, Food Safety and Standard Department, BBMP Area West Zone, Bengaluru.

Both are pending consideration.

sentences.text: 2 notice issued by respondent No.3 is without jurisdiction.
The respondents without passing any final orders, are pressurizing the NC: 2024:KHC:40947 petitioners to close down the industry.

Hence,
this Writ Petition.
3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and also the learned counsel for the respondents.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that respondent No.3 had issued impugned notice vide Annexure-A for closure of industry.
The respondent No.3 without considering the representations submitted by the petitioners, is insisting the petitioners to close down the industry.

Hence, action of respondent No.3 in insisting the petitioners to close down the industry is arbitrary,
illegal and unreasonable.
Hence, on these grounds, he prays to allow the Writ Petition.

5. Per contra learned counsel for the respondents submits that, the respondents will consider the representations submitted by the petitioners vide Annexure-E and Annexure-F and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.
Perused the records and considered the submissions of learned counsel for the parties.
7. It is not in dispute that the petitioners are carrying on a business after obtaining necessary permission from the concerned authorities.
The respondent No.3 has issued notice to the petitioners as per Annexure-A for closure of the industry.
The petitioners have submitted representations as per Annexures 'E' and 'F' for issuance of necessary license.
The respondent No.3 without considering the representations, is insisting the petitioners to close down the industry.
The respondent No.3 has no jurisdiction to insist the petitioners to close down the industry without passing any orders on the representations.

8. Hence, in view of the above discussion, I proceed to pass the following:
NC: 2024:KHC:40947 ORDER The writ petition is partly allowed.

Respondent No.3 is directed to consider the representations submitted by the petitioners as per Annexures 'E' and 'F' and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law within a period of one month from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
In the meanwhile, the respondents are directed not to take any coercive action against the petitioners' industry, till passing of orders.
All the contentions of the parties are kept open.

Sd/-
